Subject: Novus Systems vendor onboarding — PO & invoicing acceptance checklist

Hi Marie,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Per our call, I attached Redwood's AP onboarding packet so your vendor team can register us in Novus's payables system. The packet includes:
- Registered legal name + EIN/VAT fields (we have a EU VAT registration for our EU entity)
- Invoicing examples and required PO reference fields
- Banking and remit instructions (we support EFT/ACH/SEPA)
- Certificate of insurance and SOC2 summary (links inside)

Quick asks to get us live for the pilot:
1) Please confirm the exact PO fields you require on the invoice (PO number, PO line, cost center, GL code, etc.). If you have a sample PO PDF, please attach.
2) Confirm the vendor ID format and whether you will accept invoices via SFTP or only through the portal.
3) For EU invoices, do you require our VAT certificate on file or a self-certification?

I've looped in Laura (Finance) for payment terms and Rachel (Legal) for contract redlines if anything pops up. Attached: camila_ap_onboarding_packet_v3.pdf (AP packet).

Goal: receive the onboarding checklist from Novus by end of week so we can bill against your pilot PO.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:34:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Novus Systems vendor onboarding — PO & invoicing acceptance checklist

Hi Camila — thanks, packet received and looks thorough. A few clarifying questions from our side:

1) PO fields: We require PO number (required), PO line (optional but preferred), and Cost Center (required). Our portal also asks for a Project Code on some POs — will that be included on Redwood invoices?

2) Invoice delivery: For the pilot we prefer portal upload (pdf) but we can accept SFTP ingest if you want automated routing.

3) VAT: For EU entities we need the VAT registration number and a VAT certificate on file. If your EU entity issues invoices without VAT (reverse charge), we'll need supporting documentation.

4) Payment terms: Our default is Net 30. Any issues with Net 30 for the pilot?

I attached an example PO and our vendor enrollment form: novus_po_example_34567.pdf. I'll put this thread on copy to AP (acct-pay) to kick off the vendor registration.

Marie
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Novus Systems
marie.delacroix@novussystems.com

Attachments: novus_po_example_34567.pdf (PO sample)

Marie / AP team,

Thanks for the example PO — very helpful. Answers below and a short checklist we can follow to get Redwood registered and ready to invoice the pilot PO:

Checklist (what we'll provide)
- Vendor legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit-to bank details: (will supply in secure portal link)
- Redwood Tax IDs: US EIN: 12-3456789; EU VAT: EU-987654321 (certificate attached)
- W-9 equivalent: we will provide the appropriate tax form for your region
- Invoice samples: PDF invoice template with PO number and cost center mapped to our line items (we'll mirror the PO fields)

What we need from Novus
- Confirm the exact portal filename convention (we can adapt filenames)
- Confirm whether Project Code is required on this pilot PO (if yes, we'll include it on our invoices)
- Confirm preferred payment method for the pilot (ACH/SEPA) and remit-to contact for test payment

Notes on VAT: Our EU entity will invoice with VAT details as required; if reverse-charge applies we'll include the supporting note and VAT ID on the invoice. Attached: novus_vat_certificate.pdf (EU VAT certificate).

Terms: Net 30 is acceptable for the pilot. Laura, can you confirm we accept Net 30 for this engagement?

Rachel, if there are any contract items we should redline before we exchange PO/contract, please advise.

Next step: Marie / AP, when you confirm the portal details and any mandatory fields, we'll submit the enrollment form and test invoice.

Best,

Hi Camila / team,

Thanks — Novus AP confirms the following for vendor registration and pilot invoicing:
- Required invoice fields: PO Number (mandatory), PO Line (if provided), Cost Center (mandatory), Project Code (optional for this pilot).
- File delivery: Portal upload (PDF) for the pilot; SFTP can be enabled after vendor ID is issued.
- Payment method for pilot: ACH (US) / SEPA (EU) — we'll send a payment test to the remit address once vendor is active.
- VAT: Please attach the VAT certificate to the vendor profile (novus_vat_certificate.pdf accepted). Reverse-charge note is fine if included on the invoice.
- Vendor ID: We'll provision Vendor ID NV-48231 and notify when active.

Next actions for Redwood:
1) Complete our vendor enrollment form (link sent by Marie separately).
2) Upload your invoice sample PDF (include PO Number and Cost Center) to the portal.
3) Once we confirm vendor activation, we'll issue the test payment and provide Vendor ID in a separate email.

No issues with Net 30.

Regards,
